subject: Unit economics follow-up: token volumes, budget & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@fintechx.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T15:10:00Z
Subject: Recap + asks from today's discovery (Unit economics + pricing)

Thanks again for the time today, Jordan — appreciate the clear context on FintechX's roadmap. Quick recap and a few asks so we can size the right proposal and unit-econ scenarios.

TL;DR: We can support your realtime chat + batch summarization use cases. To finalize pricing scenarios we need:
- Expected token volume (monthly PATTERN): average tokens per request, peak QPS, or monthly aggregate (1M tokens buckets ok)
- Target budget range or target $/1M tokens that would be acceptable to achieve your margin targets
- Any constraints on deployment: hosted API vs dedicated GPUs vs private VPC (affects cost profiles)

From today's notes:
- Launch: beta with 50k DAU, ramp to 300k DAU in 6–9 months
- Primary features: chat with context window (~2k tokens avg), nightly batch summarization of transcripts (~50M tokens/month at later stage)
- Retention/metrics: target CAC payback < 6 months, gross margin > 65% on the product offering

I've attached a draft pricing estimate and a simple unit-econ model (redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.pdf, unit_econ_model.xlsx). If you can confirm rough monthly token volume (range is fine) and a target $/1M tokens budget, we'll run three scenarios (hosted / dedicated reserved / private) showing:
- Redwood list pricing per 1M tokens and our recommended operational config
- Estimated inference spend per feature (cost/feature)
- CAC payback sensitivity given 3 pricing bands

Next steps:
- Can you reply with a monthly token ballpark and procurement contact (if different from procurement@fintechx.com)?
- If that looks good, can we schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to review the unit-econ scenarios and discuss a mutual action plan?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments:
- redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.pdf (pricing tiers & example run-rate)
- unit_econ_model.xlsx (simple $/feature model)

From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fintechx.com
Date: 2026-10-13T09:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap + asks from today's discovery (Unit economics + pricing)

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Expected token volumes (best estimate ranges):
- Month 1 (beta): 5–10M tokens/month
- Month 3 (post-beta ramp): 40–60M tokens/month
- Month 6 (scale): 200–350M tokens/month

2) Feature breakdown / avg tokens per hit:
- Chat: ~1.8k tokens per session (prompt + response) — ~1.2M sessions/month at scale
- Summarization (batch nightly): up to 50M tokens/month at scale

3) Budget / target pricing:
- Our CFO is looking for a target inference cost of roughly $2,500–$4,000 per 1M tokens (to hit 65%+ gross margin with current pricing model). Open to discussing Dedicated reserved capacity if it materially reduces unit costs.

4) Procurement: procurement@fintechx.com (cc'd) — they'll need a ballpark and an NDA before detailed SOW.

Please push back if any of those numbers seem off. Would like the three scenarios you mentioned (hosted, dedicated, private) with the CAC payback sensitivity.

—Jordan
VP Product, FintechX

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@fintechx.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, procurement@fintechx.com
Date: 2026-10-15T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap + asks — Unit-econ scenarios attached

Jordan — thanks for the ranges, that's super helpful. Attached are three scenario snapshots (hosted / dedicated reserved / private VPC) and a populated unit-econ sheet. Highlights and assumptions below so procurement has a clean summary.

Summary (high level):
- Target price band you mentioned ($2.5k–$4k / 1M tokens) maps to our mid-to-high tier hosted pricing at scale; Dedicated reserved capacity is where we can push unit cost closer to $1.5k–$2.2k / 1M tokens depending on commit and model choice. Private VPC incurs additional fixed infra fee but similar per-token at large committed volumes.

Key assumptions used in the model:
- Model: M-Redwood-3 (optimized for chat, 2k context). We include 4x quantized variants for dedicated where applicable.
- Token calc: chat sessions avg 1.8k tokens; summarization 50M tokens/month; ramp schedule per your ranges
- Infra & ops: hosted has 10–15% margin buffer for multi-tenant infra; dedicated reduces that to ~5–8%

Cost / feature examples (illustrative at 200M tokens/month):
- Chat (per session): inference cost ~ $0.18–$0.40 per session (hosted -> dedicated) assuming 1.8k tokens/session
- Summarization (per month): inference cost ~ $90–$300k/month depending on model and reserved discounts (hosted -> dedicated)
- Effective $/1M tokens: Hosted: ~$3,200 / 1M tokens (at 200M/month profile); Dedicated (committed): ~$1,800 / 1M tokens; Private (large commit + infra): ~$1,650 / 1M tokens

Unit economics and CAC payback (simple view):
- Example ARPU per new customer feature adoption: $1.8k/year (avg across product tiers)
- CAC assumed: $6k initial (sales + onboarding)
- If feature drives incremental revenue of $1.8k/year and inference cost per customer = $120/year (chat + background jobs at scale),
  - Gross margin contribution before inference: ~ 66%
  - Net margin after inference & infra: ~ 59–62% (hosted -> dedicated)
  - CAC payback: ~ 3.3 years at current ARR-only assumptions; if feature increases monetization to $6k/customer/year (higher-tier upsell) payback drops to < 1 year.

Interpretation / asks:
- Your CFO target of $2.5k–$4k / 1M tokens is achievable on hosted at scale but depends on model mix and reserved commitments. If FintechX can commit to a 12-month reserved committed spend (e.g., $X/month), we can get to the $1.5k–$2k band.
- We recommend a two-step approach: 1) Start on hosted to validate UX & metrics (low friction), 2) Move to Dedicated reserved pool at Month 3–6 once volume stabilizes to capture unit-cost savings.

Next steps (proposed):
- Marissa & Aditya: prepare a committed pricing term sheet and SOW draft for procurement. (Deliverable: committed pricing + MA draft) — target 48 hours
- Schedule 30-min follow-up with Jordan + procurement to review the committed option and finalize NDA / SOW: suggested slots Wed 10/21 or Thu 10/22 (your timezone)

Looping in Aditya to confirm technical sizing / quantization profiles and to propose a Dedicated capacity config that matches the 200–350M tokens/month target.

Thanks — will follow up with the term sheet and a one-page summary for procurement.

Best,
Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Jordan Park <jordan.park@fintechx.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T18:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap + asks — technical sizing note

Quick technical note to support the commercial proposal:
- For the 200–350M tokens/month profile, recommended Dedicated config: 8x A100-class GPUs with auto-burst to spare capacity during peak windows; expect sustained throughput ~ 1.5k tokens/sec per GPU with quantized model path.
- Quantization & model choice: M-Redwood-3 (8-bit quant) yields ~1.6–2x cost reduction vs fp16 without material quality loss for chat workflows. We will benchmark your prompt set during POC.
- Ops & rollout: suggest 2-week validation on hosted with prefix caching enabled, then migrate to Dedicated with canary traffic for 48 hours.

I'll produce a short SOW snippet with the above config and an estimated committed discount ladder (12/24 month tiers). Will attach to the pricing term sheet Marissa is prepping.

—Aditya
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
